apps.name: DukeX
apps.subtitle: Original Xbox emulation for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
DukeX is an experimental iOS-focused frontend for xemu. It embeds the xemu core in a native Swift shell, provides an iPhone-friendly library and settings experience, and presents the Vulkan renderer through MoltenVK and a native CAMetalLayer.

DukeX v1.0.2 expands the Xbox experience with XB.Live Activity Feed, Rich Presence and playtime tracking, threaded messaging, friend requests and presence, controller landscape mode, improved AirPlay and external display support, refined achievements, and smoother news reading. A native macOS release is also available separately through GitHub Releases.

DukeX installs on iOS 16.0 or later. iOS 16 through 18 use W^X reprotection after JIT has been enabled for the process. iOS 26 or later requires StikDebug with Universal.js assigned to the DukeX bundle identifier. Supported hardware starts at Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 and newer.

DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, or signing certificates. Users and testers are required to provide their own legally obtained files. DukeX is intended solely for legitimate emulation and preservation purposes, and is not designed for use with pirated materials.

versions.localizedDescription:
- First native macOS release is available separately through GitHub Releases as a drag-to-Applications DMG.
- XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking let friends see what you are playing while DukeX tracks supported sessions.
- XB.Live messaging now supports threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox messages.
- Expanded social features add friend requests, friend management, and richer presence details.
- New Activity Feed combines XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks, and community updates.
- Controller landscape mode brings a controller-first browsing and launch experience on iOS.
- Expanded AirPlay and external display handling improves big-screen play.
- Achievements, news article reading, cloud-save sync metadata, and game tile spacing have been refined.
- DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, or copyrighted content.

- Partnership with XB.Live introduces profile integration for achievements, friends, messages, community events, and cloud sync support.
- Core rendering and performance handling have been improved for better stability across more titles.
- Touch Controls now support .manicskin layouts, .deltaskin and .gammaskin imports, haptic feedback, and the official DukeX Default skin.
- AirPlay support lets compatible devices send gameplay to larger displays.
- Themes, automatic cover art retrieval, and DukeX URL scheme support expand personalization and launch-link workflows.
- Minimum iOS support has been experimentally lowered to iOS 16 on A14/M1 or newer hardware.
- Known issue: after device rotation, some touch controls may stop functioning as intended. For this release, launch games in the orientation you plan to play in.

Initial DukeX release with native SwiftUI library, profile, and settings tabs; game-library sorting by favorites, title, Live support, and recently played; portrait and landscape column controls; Insignia-oriented NAT defaults and live indicators; built-in FPS/system statistics; app-owned launch logs; and the current iOS 16 through 18 W^X JIT path plus the iOS 26+ StikDebug Universal.js workflow.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: DukeX uses Bluetooth to read connected game controller battery information.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: DukeX uses Bluetooth to read connected game controller battery information.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: DukeX can use the front camera to test Xbox Video Chat camera peripheral emulation.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DukeX can use the microphone to test Xbox Live Communicator support.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: DukeX can use device tilt to subtly move animated theme backgrounds.
